short_description: Live CPU and RAM graphs of your Mac, Windows or Linux computer, over Wi-Fi or a USB cable.
description:
CPU and RAM of your computer, live on the front screen. CPU on the left, RAM on the right: each half shows the current value and a graph that scrolls one column per sample, from 18 seconds to 18 minutes of history.

The numbers come from [Glances](https://nicolargo.github.io/glances/), running on your computer. It serves only CPU and memory: no process list, disks or network details.

**Setup:** run the installer on your Mac, Windows PC or Linux computer, one line in Terminal or PowerShell: [github.com/mrlunev/busybar-host-load](https://github.com/mrlunev/busybar-host-load#install). It installs Glances with its own Python, starts it at every login, finds the bar over USB or Wi-Fi, installs the app and fills in its settings.

**Settings** in the bar's web interface, **Apps → Host Load**: the computer's address, and how often to update, from 0.5 to 30 seconds.

**Controls:** a short press of **Back** quits.
